summary.text: A King of Egypt and son of Poseidon and Libya. He was the father of the twin brothers Danaus and Aegyptus.

story.text: Belus was the son of Poseidon and Libya, and the twin brother of Agenor. While Agenor departed for Phoenicia, Belus remained in Egypt and ruled over the land.

He married Anchinoe, a daughter of the river god Nilus, and fathered twin sons of his own: Danaus and Aegyptus. Upon his death, the kingdom was divided, leading to a bitter and murderous rivalry between his sons.
